title: Symmetry-breaking chelation enables room-temperature all-optical spin coherence readout of aqueous Cu(II) for chemoselective discrimination
summary: Optical initialization and readout of molecular electron spins in water remains challenging for 3d transition-metal complexes. Their Laporte-forbidden d-d transitions yield weak transition dipole moments, so optical spin detection in aqueous Cu(II) previously required ~1 M concentrations. Here we overcome this constraint through symmetry-breaking chelation. Coordinating Cu(II) with EDTA imposes a non-centrosymmetric ligand field with enhanced metal-ligand covalency, relaxing Laporte restrictions and amplifying d-d transition dipole moments.
